name: How do I choose the right contractor for window replacement?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for window replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for window replacement, look for experience, proper licensing, and insurance. Check for positive customer reviews and request references. A reliable contractor should offer a detailed, written estimate, explain product options clearly, and provide transparent timelines. Ensure they understand local building codes and can manage any necessary permits. Open communication and a clear warranty on both products and labor are also key indicators of a trustworthy professional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor with experience, proper licensing, good reviews, and a clear, written estimate, ensuring they understand local codes and warranties.
